/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import json
import subprocess

def browser(*args):
    return json.loads(subprocess.check_output([\"python3\", \"browser.py\", *args], text=True))

for width, height in [(\"390\", \"844\"), (\"1280\", \"800\")]:
    browser(\"open\", width, height)
    office = browser(\"inspect\", \"#office\")[\"result\"]
    submit = browser(\"inspect\", \"#send\")[\"result\"]
    clear = browser(\"inspect\", \"#clear\")[\"result\"]
    assert submit[\"visual\"] == office[\"visual\"]
    assert clear[\"visual\"][\"bg\"] "'!= submit["visual"]["bg"]
    for button in (submit, clear):
        x, y, w, h = button["bounds"]
        assert 0 <= x <= x + w <= int(width) and 0 <= y <= y + h <= int(height)
    for expected in ("office", "vessel", "slot", "clear", "send"):
        state = browser("press", "Tab")
        assert state["active"]["id"] == expected, state
    assert "solid 3px" in state["active"]["visual"]["outline"], state
    assert browser("press", "Enter")["status"] == "Enter a vessel name."
    browser("fill", "#vessel", "  Test vessel  ")
    browser("select", "#slot", "Afternoon")
    assert browser("click", "#send")["status"] == "Arrival requested for Test vessel · Afternoon."
    assert browser("click", "#clear")["status"] == ""
    assert browser("inspect", "#vessel")["result"]["value"] == ""
    assert browser("inspect", "#slot")["result"]["value"] == "Morning"
    print(f"{width}×{height}: button hierarchy, keyboard focus, validation, submission, and reset passed")
PY'
